Three more reports (September, October and November 2026 editions) were handled after this was written. They add 27 leaders that are being analysed now. This text still describes the sixteen games analysed from the July and August editions and is written again when the new leaders are settled.

Written 27 Nov 2026 from the sixteen finished art analyses. Every statement names the games it rests on; each game's own report holds the sheets, the real screens and the measured figures behind it.

What this covers, and what it does not

The two market reports handled so far (Eilers-Fantini, U.S. Online Game Performance, July and August 2026 editions) name 30 leading slot games between them. 16 are analysed. 14 could not be, and the gap is not random:

ProviderLeadersAnalysedWhy the rest are missing
IGT65Cash Eruption High Stakes has no public demo yet
Octoplay66
Light & Wonder33
AGS11
Inspired11
Games Global80Every public demo is refused for visitors from the United States, where our analysis machine sits
White Hat Studios20No public demo; the provider's own is behind a client login
Aristocrat10Demo only behind an account
Evolution10Access denied and an age gate
ReelPlay10The game server did not answer

So this is the art of IGT, Octoplay and Light & Wonder with two guests, not of the whole list. Games Global, the largest single group among the leaders, is absent, and nothing below should be read as describing its games.

Three more limits apply to every game:

  • Bonus rounds are often read, not seen. A free-play session reaches what chance gives it. Where a feature did not come, its art is read from the files and marked so in the game's report.
  • Most rigs are not drawn. Our tool draws Spine 3.x skeletons. Twelve of the sixteen games use Spine 4.x, so their motion is read from the skeleton files, the frame sequences and the real screens.
  • Measured figures describe the art package, not the screen. Brightness, warmth and palette are measured over every texture a game ships. A game with many frames of one character leans towards that character's colours (Huff N Puff Money Mansion: three wolf rigs are 132 of its 349 textures).

Three families of look

The sixteen games fall into three groups. The grouping is our reading.

FamilyGamesWhat defines it
The classic machine, re-dressedCash Eruption, Triple Cash Eruption, Cleopatra, Capital Gains, 777 Hot Reels Megacharged, Fire Rail Express, Mega Cash BoostFruit, sevens, bells, letters or money icons, kept plain. The art effort goes into the money object and the feature, not the paytable. Little or no scenery, and at most one character.
The glossy cartoon castHuff N Even More Puff Grand, Huff N Lots Of Goals, Huff N Puff Money Mansion, Super Cash Boost Big Bad Bonus, Bigger Piggy Bank Superwheel, The Lucky FellaToy-bright, rounded, glossy characters and props in a storybook or stage setting, with the prizes built into the scene.
The themed world with one figureMystery Of The Lamp Secret Bazaar, Money Gong Emperor, Serpent GoldA place or a culture (bazaar, Chinese good fortune, lost temple) carried by one figure or one emblem, with realistic or ornamental objects as symbols.

Two things stand out across the families:

  • Pigs. Five of the sixteen games are built on pigs: the three Huff N Puff games and Super Cash Boost tell the Three Little Pigs, and Bigger Piggy Bank is a piggy-bank heist. A sixth leader, Coin Collect Piggy Patrons, carries pigs in its title; it is blocked, so what its art looks like is not known.
  • No game here is dark, gritty or realistic in its characters. Where a figure appears it is friendly: a laughing emperor (Money Gong Emperor), a friendly genie (Mystery Of The Lamp), a laughing leprechaun (The Lucky Fella), toy pigs, and a wolf dressed as a referee (Huff N Lots Of Goals).

What the leaders share

1. Colour is a code, not decoration

Every analysed game that has prize tiers or several features gives each one a fixed colour and repeats it on every surface that names it. This is the single most consistent finding.

  • Per feature: red, green and blue each mean one feature on fireball, border, volcano, label and buy card (Triple Cash Eruption); red Collect, green Clone, blue Double on head, gems, lights and words (Serpent Gold); one hue per lamp (Mystery Of The Lamp).
  • Per prize tier: on coin, plaque, wheel wedge and win word (Fire Rail Express, Huff N Even More Puff Grand, Huff N Lots Of Goals, Huff N Puff Money Mansion, Bigger Piggy Bank, Money Gong Emperor).
  • As the whole design: blue is Cash, gold is Jackpot, red is both, down to the three words of the logo (Mega Cash Boost); a blue 7, a purple 77 and a red 777 each tied to the jackpot of its colour (777 Hot Reels Megacharged).
  • As a scale: the same five rainbow steps rank the royals and the jackpots (The Lucky Fella); straw, wood and brick rank Wilds, houses, prize ladders and win tiers (Super Cash Boost).

2. A dark, plain reel window, and warm symbols on a cool ground

The symbols are kept readable by what is behind them, not by outlines or size.

  • A black or near-black board with saturated symbols: Capital Gains, Bigger Piggy Bank, Money Gong Emperor, Serpent Gold.
  • A cool cell under warm symbols: a teal board in a red room (Cash Eruption, Triple Cash Eruption); a background measured 84% cool behind feature symbols measured 88% warm (Huff N Even More Puff Grand).
  • One colour per symbol, so the board is read by colour before shape: a cloth colour per symbol (Cleopatra), a tile colour per high symbol (Capital Gains), a halo per symbol (Mystery Of The Lamp).
  • A photoreal backdrop can sit behind stylised symbols when the board between them is dark and plain (Serpent Gold).

3. The prize is always in sight

The top prizes and the feature's progress are part of the base-game picture, not a meter in a corner.

  • The scene is the prize board: the mansion's front holds the prizes (Huff N Puff Money Mansion); fifteen prize plates take more of the screen than the reels (Mega Cash Boost); the cabinet shows every pay above the reels (777 Hot Reels Megacharged).
  • A prize wheel turns behind see-through reels on every spin (Huff N Even More Puff Grand, Huff N Lots Of Goals).
  • Progress is an object that changes: lamps with growing gold piles (Mystery Of The Lamp); lava rising on three cones (Triple Cash Eruption); goals filling with balls (Huff N Lots Of Goals); a stone serpent heating to lava (Serpent Gold); pots filling with gold (The Lucky Fella).
  • Jackpot plaques stand beside or above the reels through the base game: six down the side (Huff N Even More Puff Grand), four at the side (Huff N Puff Money Mansion), five banners above (The Lucky Fella), three ladders around the reels (Super Cash Boost).

4. Scenery is cheap or absent

None of the sixteen spends its budget on a landscape.

  • No scene at all: a flat green field (Capital Gains); a patterned wall (Money Gong Emperor); a one-colour dusk (Cleopatra); tinted white light shapes and not one background picture (Mega Cash Boost); a shamrock pattern (The Lucky Fella).
  • One picture, unlayered: single JPEG backgrounds (Cash Eruption, Money Gong Emperor).
  • Depth from light, not painting: mirrored ray pictures and eight views of one 3D sign (777 Hot Reels Megacharged).
  • The cartoon family paints more (a storybook garden, a stadium, a mansion, a valley), and still as one picture per scene.

5. One emblem, motif or figure carries the game

  • One emblem at several sizes: the gong is symbol, title coin, trigger and bonus wheel centre (Money Gong Emperor).
  • One creature for every mechanic: the snake is Wild, feature symbols, collectors, progress statue and screen wipe (Serpent Gold).
  • One small mark on plain objects: a pig's snout on at least nine pieces (Bigger Piggy Bank); a snout on each letter and tool (Super Cash Boost); a heart-leaf clover on coin, pipe, hat and Scatter (The Lucky Fella); a step-fret on every frame and button (Cash Eruption).
  • One drawing used several ways: one face as loading picture, logo and wild (Cleopatra); one flaming seven recoloured as the whole high-symbol set, the Wild and the logo (777 Hot Reels Megacharged); one leprechaun rig as intro figure and two symbols (The Lucky Fella); one train picture (Fire Rail Express).
  • One effect family: blue lightning (Capital Gains), white lightning (Mega Cash Boost), tinted smoke (Mystery Of The Lamp), flat white smoke and wind (Super Cash Boost).

6. A feature mode is a recolour, a regrade or a re-dress

  • Recolour only: the same background in red with a red-edged reel window (Capital Gains); backdrop hue and cell ground (Cleopatra); the same hall pushed to red (Cash Eruption); purple night to orange blaze (777 Hot Reels Megacharged); tint values alone (Mega Cash Boost); green to purple (The Lucky Fella).
  • Regrade of one picture: day jungle to dusk (Serpent Gold); day and night stadium on one drawing (Huff N Lots Of Goals); day and sunset on one composition (Super Cash Boost).
  • The exceptions repaint: a separate crater scene for the bonus (Triple Cash Eruption), a cave beside the bazaar (Mystery Of The Lamp), a night mansion with its own lit windows (Huff N Puff Money Mansion).

7. Grades and tiers are swaps on one rig

  • Three saws, four houses and eleven banners on shared rigs and canvas sizes (Huff N Even More Puff Grand); two ball colours, two goals and three trophy metals (Huff N Lots Of Goals); straw, stick and brick (Huff N Puff Money Mansion).
  • Three Snakes on one rig (Serpent Gold); three pigs on one portrait layout (Super Cash Boost).
  • Pink to gold as the upgrade for every pig, at four sizes (Bigger Piggy Bank).
  • One cone in three colours and one fireball in four (Triple Cash Eruption).

8. The celebration is made from the cast

  • The big win is the wolf blowing down a better house per tier, with the game's own coin, hat and saw as particles (Huff N Even More Puff Grand, read from the files); the wolf and three trophies (Huff N Lots Of Goals, read from the files).
  • The BIG WIN reuses the Wild pig's bust and the scene's props (Super Cash Boost, seen).
  • Small wins are quiet: ten times the bet got a gold burst and a caption (Huff N Lots Of Goals, seen).

How they are built

Stills first, motion on top

How motion is madeGames
Frame sequences and stills only, no rigCapital Gains (854 frames), Cleopatra (611 frames)
Timelines over still pictures, with short fire loopsCash Eruption
Spine rigs moving still pictures, plus drawn sequences for fire, smoke and lightTriple Cash Eruption, Mystery Of The Lamp, Money Gong Emperor, all six Octoplay games
Spine rigs, with whole drawn sequences for acting and destructionthe three Huff N Puff games
Spine rigs of small parts on almost every symbolBigger Piggy Bank (64 skeletons)

The pattern under the table: a strong still per piece, and a shared kit of overlays. A win version is the reel picture plus an outline glow, a spark and a flame loop (Cash Eruption). A full-height character feels alive with four moving pieces and two flame loops over a painting (Cash Eruption). A train is one picture with animated wheel, rods and sparks (Fire Rail Express). A statue is one still with glow layers (Serpent Gold).

Where real animation is spent, it is spent in one place: the wolf's face and the big-win pigs (Huff N Puff Money Mansion), a 25-frame turn for each diamond (Mega Cash Boost), an 80-frame wild (Cleopatra), a pig smashing into 14 pre-cut shards (Bigger Piggy Bank). The Light & Wonder games state the rule: rig what moves mechanically, draw what is chaotic.

Production habits worth knowing

  • Effects ship white and are tinted in the game. One flame sequence serves every jackpot colour (Fire Rail Express); the same flame files serve two games (777 Hot Reels Megacharged); half of all drawn frames are reusable white sparkle and smoke (The Lucky Fella); also Serpent Gold and Mega Cash Boost.
  • Light effects are drawn on black and added, apart from the solid art (Money Gong Emperor, Mystery Of The Lamp, Triple Cash Eruption); an additive "Light" copy of each symbol makes its win flash (Bigger Piggy Bank).
  • Boards ship grey and are tinted per mode (The Lucky Fella, Super Cash Boost).
  • Words are separate from what they label and sit in a few localised files (all six Octoplay games; English and Spanish versions in the Huff N Puff games; six languages of win words in Bigger Piggy Bank).
  • Each reel symbol ships sharp and motion-blurred (Money Gong Emperor, Mystery Of The Lamp, Triple Cash Eruption).
  • Numbers are treated as art: several drawn numeral sets, each tied to one place (Money Gong Emperor, Triple Cash Eruption, Serpent Gold); values baked into pictures (Capital Gains).
  • The loading screen sells the features as three captioned cards (Capital Gains, Huff N Puff Money Mansion).

New games on proven frames

  • A reskin, piece for piece. Huff N Lots Of Goals keeps the building-site games' file and animation names (saw, hard hat, houses, toolboxes) under football art. That it is the earlier game re-dressed is inference from those names; the mechanics, rigs and timings look kept and only the pictures changed.
  • One framework, six looks. The six Octoplay games share a shell, fonts, a file layout and many skeleton names, and still share almost no picture of their own art. The same framework carries a neon scoreboard with no scene (Mega Cash Boost) and an illustrated character game (The Lucky Fella).
  • A sequel from little new art: two extra logo words, 25 lightning frames and a jackpot row (777 Hot Reels Megacharged).

What it costs when it goes wrong

  • Three near-identical wolf rigs on 132 atlas pages and a stray sequence from another game (Huff N Puff Money Mansion).
  • The same sequences packed several times (Triple Cash Eruption); five 4096 px pages for one door opening (Bigger Piggy Bank); 22 pages for one dust blast (Huff N Lots Of Goals).
  • A shared platform feature left in another finish looks bolted on (Bigger Piggy Bank's Super Wheel).

The measured picture

The tables under this text hold each game's palette, tone and package size, all measured from pixels. Read across them:

  • Dark packages. Twelve of the sixteen measure under 0.5 in brightness; the four above are Huff N Lots Of Goals (0.65), Mega Cash Boost (0.63), Huff N Puff Money Mansion (0.55) and Super Cash Boost (0.51).
  • Warm packages. Thirteen measure warmer than cool. The exceptions are Huff N Puff Money Mansion (cool 0.64, pulled by its wolf frames), Super Cash Boost and Capital Gains, both near balance. The warmest are Cleopatra (0.90) and Cash Eruption (0.87).
  • A very dark colour leads most palettes. The largest palette colour is black or a near-black tint in eleven of the sixteen games.
  • Size says little about rank. Packages run from 19 textures and 705 sprites (Cleopatra) to 349 textures and 3,579 sprites (Huff N Puff Money Mansion). The Octoplay games hold 454 to 802 sprites each on two or three atlas pages.

What is still open

  • Fourteen leaders, eight of them Games Global's. They need a machine outside the United States, or demo links from the providers or the product team.
  • Bonus rounds not seen in several games: the Hold & Win of Super Cash Boost and The Lucky Fella, every feature of the three Huff N Puff games, the feature scenes of Money Gong Emperor, the Super Wheel of Bigger Piggy Bank. Longer played sessions would settle them.
  • Rigs not drawn for the twelve Spine 4.x games.
  • Desktop landscape only. Portrait and phone layouts were not captured for any game; several ship them.
  • Huff N Lots Of Goals was read from the UK build; that its art matches the US game is inference.

Art direction, game by game Read

Style
GameStyle
Cash EruptionThree manners side by side. The regular symbols are stylised, glossy, toy-like objects with a gold rim and small engraved spirals. The fireball, the flames and the win effects are photographic fire. The wild is a realistic painted pin-up figure in an Aztec or Maya costume. The setting is 3D-rendered stone architecture; the bonus backdrop is a flatter, posterised painting of a volcano.
Huff N Even More Puff GrandFamily-animation cartoon. Pigs and wolf are rounded mascots with big heads and readable expressions; tools (saw, hard hat, tape, toolbox) are chunky and simplified; houses are doll's-house fronts whose material is exaggerated (straw, logs, brick, pale stone). Prize art borrows from fairground and work-site signage.
Fire Rail Express Hold And WinGlossy casino illustration with a 3D-rendered look for the train, coins and symbols, set against graphic paper ephemera (postcards and tickets printed with engravings) and Wild West poster lettering. The reel board itself is restrained Art Deco.
Money Gong EmpressTwo manners side by side. Symbols, pots, gong and firecrackers are glossy, toy-like stylised objects. The empress is a realistic painted figure. The setting is not a place but ornament: a purple ground pressed with a wave-scale pattern, cloud scrolls and Greek-key bands. The interface buttons are a neutral charcoal set outside the theme, except the game's own red and green Bonus Buy buttons.
Mega Cash Boost Hold And WinFlat neon graphic design around glossy 3D-look symbols. The backdrop, the frame and the prize plates are pure light and outline; the fruit, bolts and wild button are airbrushed casino illustration; the diamonds are low-polygon gems. Everything leans: letters, plates and beams share one forward slant.
Freedom 250x Boost Hold And WinGlossy realistic casino illustration with a sticker finish. Objects, medals and portraits are fully painted and idealised; the backdrop is flat graphic design. The portraits are warm caricature, close to animated-film character design, while the emblems and the statue stay realistic.
Frankensteins FortuneFamily-animation cartoon horror with a 3D-look painted finish. Frankie and the Bride have big heads, heavy lids and small bodies; props (hand, ray gun, control box, brain jars, specimen jars) are rounded and toy-like. Nothing is gory: stitches, bolts, brains and eyeballs are played as sweets and toys. Lettering is horror-comic: dripping green words and fat gold slabs.
Huff N Lots Of GoalsFamily-animation cartoon. Pigs are rounded mascots with big heads (a face-painted fan, a player, a piglet); the wolf is a hand-drawn comic villain dressed as the referee; boots, whistle, ball and trophies are chunky toys. Around them the game uses sports-sticker graphics: halftone dots, torn brush bands, slanted italic titles.
3 Blazing Chilis Hold And WinFamily animated-feature illustration throughout: a storybook street, a soft caricature chef, plump glossy food symbols and comic poster lettering. Unlike many games of this kind there is no gap between a realistic world and stylised game pieces; background, character and symbols share one rounded, friendly manner, the symbols only more saturated and glossier. Inference: the two street pictures and the chef have the look of an image model's work finished by hand (the night street repeats the day street object for object); frame, boards, lettering and effects are drawn in the usual production way.
The Goonies Quest For Treasure 2Two registers side by side. Likeness art (four portrait symbols and one full-length figure) is semi-realistic film-poster painting. Everything else is stylised painted cartoon realism: props such as chests, coins, a ship's wheel, scrolls and chains painted with full materials, and a faceted, animation-background cave. One-Eyed Willy, a skull in a green tricorn hat with a gold eye patch, is the mascot and appears as symbol, map icon, intro host and transition mark.
Triple Cash EruptionTwo registers side by side. The symbols are a traditional fruit set (two sevens, bell, melon, grapes, plum, orange, lemon, cherries) drawn as rounded, glossy 3D-look objects with a small engraved swirl each. The world around them is flat, hard-edged poster painting: a ruined temple for the base game, a crater under a spiral sky for the bonus. The feature pieces (fireballs, lava, eruptions) look simulated rather than drawn.
Break The Diamond PiggyBright 3D-look cartoon in the manner of a family animation film, with caricature pigs as the stars (a cigar-and-cocktail tourist and a pin-up in sequins) and polished toy-like objects around them. The world is clean, new and expensive: white ship, blue pools, gold everywhere. One motif brands everything: the pig's snout, on the royals, the coin's back, the padlock, the clock and the flying tokens.
Bigger Piggy Bank SuperwheelGlossy cartoon with a soft 3D-look: fat, rounded, toy-like objects with no outlines, and thick outlined balloon lettering for every word. The pig is the only character and appears as symbol, mascot, lock, clasp, coin stamp and win-line head. The Super Wheel and the gamble wheel are flatter and more graphic, in a television game-show manner.
777 Hot Reels MegachargedGlossy sticker-like symbols with gold keylines, Western slab-serif lettering, and neon line work, on an abstract backdrop of light rays. The only solid scenery is a set of pre-rendered 777 blocks in steep perspective. Nothing is a character and nothing is a place.
Capital GainsCasino-floor object illustration, carried over from a land-based cabinet (inference from the cabinet-style signage, credit-based pays and bet-level buttons). Everything is a thing of wealth shown as an icon: vault door, diamond, gold bars, banknotes, coins, money bag, currency signs, card letters. The setting is an abstract banknote pattern, not a scene; the only place the game ever shows is the gold-ringed vault chamber of the bonus.
CleopatraCasino cabinet glass art: comic-style glamour illustration with hard outlines for Cleopatra and the logo, airbrushed gold-and-enamel objects for the picture symbols, gold Art Nouveau letters with lotus buds for the card ranks, and a flat poster-like Sphinx for the scatter. The cabinet and plaques are cleaner, smoother illustration; the backdrop is a one-hue tinted photo-based picture (inference); the one fire effect is naturalistic.
Mystery Of The Lamp Secret BazaarPainterly realism for the scene and the picture symbols (market goods drawn as still lifes), rendered 3D for everything that moves in space (the genie, lamps, coins, gems, tiles), and ornamental gold scrollwork on deep red for the frame and plaques. The lettering is a family of its own: storybook display scripts with 3D extrusion.
The Lucky Fella Hold And WinChunky 3D-look casino illustration with storybook proportions: rounded props (mug, pipe, barrel, boot, mushroom, pots), a big-headed family-animation character, and fairground lettering. The backdrop is a flat pattern, not a landscape. Nothing is straight: the frame, the board's outline and the banners all wobble or curl.
Serpent Gold Hold And WinTwo registers kept apart on purpose. The world (two jungle scenes, branches, birds) is photoreal painted concept art with soft haze; the game pieces (letters, props, coin, Snakes, plates, frame) are stylised casino art with thick gold rims, enamel colour and Mesoamerican step-fret ornament. The stone serpent and the temple walls sit between the two. Inference: the backgrounds have the look of an image model's picture retouched by hand; the symbols and interface are drawn in the usual production way.
Huff N Puff Money MansionFamily-animation cartoon. Pigs and wolf are rounded mascots with big heads and readable expressions; tools (hard hat, hammer, paint brush, cones, toolbox) are chunky and simplified; houses are doll's-house fronts whose material is exaggerated (straw, logs, brick, gold brick). Signs and transitions borrow from road-works: hazard stripes, caution tape, a diamond road sign.
Money Gong EmperorTwo manners side by side. Symbols, pots, gong and firecrackers are glossy, toy-like stylised objects. The emperor is a realistic painted figure. The setting is not a place but ornament: a red ground pressed with a wave-scale pattern, cloud scrolls and Greek-key bands. The interface buttons are a neutral charcoal set outside the theme.
Super Cash Boost Big Bad BonusStorybook cartoon in two registers: painted animation-background landscapes and feature-film style characters (the wolf, three pigs), against inflated glossy letters and toy tools with a pig's snout worked into each. Interface plates are the materials themselves, a straw bale, a plank, a brick panel.
Zeus vs Hades POPStylised 3D-look digital painting in a family-animation manner. Characters have large heads, barrel torsos and big hands; Zeus is round and friendly, Hades angular with spikes, pointed ears and claws; Pegasus is cute and pastel. Low symbols are extruded slab-serif letters. Architecture (temple, prize bar, logo slab) is chunky carved stone with Greek key borders.
Rendering
GameRendering
Cash EruptionSmooth airbrushed gradients with hard silhouettes, a gold outline, one white star glint and a drop shadow on every regular symbol. Frames and panels are flat fretwork ornament with no depth. Fire is soft and bright with sharp embers. Nothing has a drawn black outline except the flat black value digits on the fireballs.
Huff N Even More Puff GrandSmooth digital painting with airbrushed gradients, strong white gloss highlights, a thin outline of a darker tone and often a pale rim so pieces lift off the dark reel backing. Lettering is fat, bevelled, outlined and rimmed. Effects are flat hand-drawn frames with glow. The background is the one finely textured painting.
Fire Rail Express Hold And WinSmooth airbrushed volumes, pinpoint highlights and hard outer edges on every object; soft additive glows and cartoon fire for effects. Symbols carry a warm rim light so they sit in the fire's glow.
Money Gong EmpressSmooth airbrushed gradients with hard silhouettes, a gold or light rim and white star glints on every object; lettering with a white outline and a dark extrusion; effects as soft light on black, many of them greyscale. Nothing has a drawn black outline. Measured hard-edged overall (soft edge 0.075).
Mega Cash Boost Hold And WinTwo kinds only. Light: white shapes with feathered edges, tinted and added by the game (backdrop soft edge 0.713, lightning 0.738, glows 0.951). Objects: smooth volumes or flat facets with hard outer edges and a thin blue rim (fruit 0.075, diamonds 0.042, boost 0.1). Lettering has a two-band chrome face with a hard horizon line and a stepped extruded side.
Freedom 250x Boost Hold And WinThree kinds. Painted objects with smooth blended volume, fine detail and hard outer edges (emblems soft edge 0.147, jackpot coins 0.121, help pictures 0.037), each pay symbol on a thick white outline. Flat gradients for the backdrop and the board panel. White light sprites with feathered edges, tinted and added by the game (glows 0.898, sparks 0.88, fireworks 0.909). Lettering is extruded with a lighter upper band, a gold keyline and a navy or dark red block shadow.
Frankensteins FortuneSmooth gradients, clean hard silhouettes, no line outlines (measured: 5% soft edge over the game's art). Detail and gloss are spent on the symbols, the jars and Frankie; backgrounds are hazy paintings kept empty in the middle. Every glow, arc and burst is a separate layer on black, added on top.
Huff N Lots Of GoalsSmooth digital painting with airbrushed gradients, white gloss, a thin darker outline and a pale rim so pieces lift off the dark reel window. Lettering is fat, bevelled, outlined. The wolf's faces and all smoke, wind and sparkle are flat hand-drawn frames. The stadium is opaque brushwork with a crowd made of dabs.
3 Blazing Chilis Hold And WinBackgrounds: painted gradients with brush texture and no outlines. Chef: smooth 3D-like shading with a warm rim. Symbols: strong gradients, long white speculars, a dark outline, each on the dark plank board. Lettering: two-tone gradients with a top bevel, dark outline and lower extrusion. Fire: cel-painted licks in two or three tones with a soft glow. Smoke and light: white sprites tinted by the engine.
The Goonies Quest For Treasure 2Fully painted, no line outlines on objects; heavy dark outlines only on lettering. Props carry real material detail (wood grain, rust, hammered metal) at small sizes with hard top-left highlights. The cave is flat faceted planes with soft gradients only in light. Light effects are separate soft additive pictures (the files sit on black or are plain glows), so glow is a layer, not paint.
Triple Cash EruptionSymbols: smooth airbrushed volume, a hard white specular spot, a four-point sparkle, a thin gold rim on the premium ones, no outlines. Backgrounds: a few flat tones per shape, crisp edges, strong vignette to black. Effects: soft glowing frames on black grounds. Interface plates are clean teal enamel with a gold rim.
Break The Diamond PiggySmooth airbrushed volumes with hard cut edges for every object (soft edge: reel board 0.034, backdrops 0.034, jackpot plates 0.058, golden piggy banks 0.078, Ms. Piggy 0.086, high symbols 0.089, Mr. Piggy 0.125), flat-faceted crystal for the diamonds and the Diamond Piggy, and soft white light for every effect (bursts 0.909, rays 0.954). Lettering is flat two-tone with a thick outline.
Bigger Piggy Bank SuperwheelSmooth airbrushed gradients, a broad soft highlight and small hard white glints on every round form; gold is painted yellow-to-brown, not rendered. Backgrounds are clean stylised interiors in one-point perspective with detail kept at the vault door. Only the vault door's opening (31 frames) and the big-win gems read as true 3D renders.
777 Hot Reels MegachargedSmooth airbrushed enamel with one hard glint on symbols; flat neon outlines with glow for plaques, frames and jackpot wins; flat two-tone cartoon fire and white lightning for effects; soft gradient rays for the ground. Every symbol carries its own keyline and halo.
Capital GainsSmooth airbrushed gradients, hard silhouettes and bright specular streaks; 12% of edges measure soft over the whole game. High symbols sit on a rounded tile of their own colour; low symbols are bevelled letters with a white edge and a black outline. Titles are extruded, bevelled display lettering. Lightning is the one soft, glowing family (77% soft edges).
CleopatraHard-edged throughout (soft edge 0.05 over the game's art), smooth airbrushed gradients inside thin dark outlines, white streak highlights on gold, a woven texture on the symbol cloths and a fibre texture on the free-spin papyrus. Everything is a flat finished picture: nothing is layered or lit by the scene.
Mystery Of The Lamp Secret BazaarNo outlines anywhere. Objects are softly lit and detailed; each picture symbol sits in a halo of coloured smoke instead of a tile. Gold is thin, crisp and bright; glass buttons and lamps have a hard top highlight. Effects are photographic smoke, fire and lightning added over the art.
The Lucky Fella Hold And WinSmooth airbrushed volumes with hard outer edges for every object (soft edge 0.05 to 0.2: character 0.059, pipe 0.051, jackpot banners 0.114, high symbols 0.197), a green rim light under most props, and soft light for everything magical (rainbow effects 0.941, sparkles 0.825, bursts 0.827). Lettering has a two-tone face with a hard horizon, a thick rim and an extruded side.
Serpent Gold Hold And WinBackgrounds: soft atmospheric depth, no outlines. Symbols: smooth gradients, hard speculars, a dark outline and a thin yellow-green edge glow that lifts them off the dark panel. Snakes: faceted glossy scales and gold trim. Lettering: two-tone gradient fills with a light inner edge and dark outline. Effects: white sprites tinted by the engine, with fire and lava painted in colour.
Huff N Puff Money MansionSmooth digital painting with airbrushed gradients, strong white gloss highlights, a darker outline and often a pale rim so pieces lift off the dark reel panel. Lettering is fat, bevelled, outlined and rimmed. Effects are flat hand-drawn shapes with glow (fire swirls, wind lines, splashes). The wolf and the big-win pigs are whole softly shaded frames, close to pre-rendered animation. The background is drawn brick by brick.
Money Gong EmperorSmooth airbrushed gradients with hard silhouettes, a gold or light rim and white star glints on every object; lettering with a white outline and a dark extrusion; effects as soft light on black. Nothing has a drawn black outline. Measured hard-edged overall (soft edge 0.07).
Super Cash Boost Big Bad BonusBackgrounds and props are painterly with visible brushwork; characters are smoothly blended with sharp speculars and a light rim; letters, tools, logo and numerals are flat gradients with gloss bands and thick dark outlines. Effects are flat white hand-drawn smoke, dust and wind, with soft white glows added on top.
Zeus vs Hades POPSmooth gradients that read like a soft 3D render, clean hard silhouettes and no line outlines anywhere. Detail is concentrated in faces, gold trim and jewellery; backgrounds are soft-focus paintings kept low in detail so the board reads first. Effects are the opposite: thin, sharp, bright shapes with glow.
Colour
GameColour
Cash EruptionRed, black and gold, with teal as the single counter-colour. Measured over the game's own art, the palette is led by near-black #170507, dark red #5c0d0f and red #9b130f and #ee2509, then orange #ed9e1c and gold #f7dd5b; saturation 80%, warm 87% against cool 9%. The reel cells are teal (#07998e, #036156) in the base game, so the board separates from the red hall (#a31d05); in the free spins the cells turn red (#9b0108) and the hall brighter red (#f52205). The bonus adds magenta (#7e072a and a 19% magenta share of hues). Each fruit owns one hue. The four prize tiers own one flat text colour each: red Grand, pink Major (#fb67b1), green Minor (#32fa64), cyan Mini (#31c6f7). The spin button is green.
Huff N Even More Puff GrandWarm cast on a cool stage. Feature and prize art is gold, orange and red (hat and saw rig: #8e2215, #f8ae0c, #d84f07, 88% warm); the background is 84% cool (#143240, #2f7040, #455787, #0d1a88) and the wolf is blue-violet (#56558c). Royals are a single emerald green (#1a6348). Prize tiers keep one colour each wherever they appear: magenta Mini, green Minor, blue Major, red Grand, white-blue Ultra. Measured over the game's own captured art: black #080907 13%, dark blue #162946 7%, orange #f4aa14 7%, dark red #590e23 6%.
Fire Rail Express Hold And WinGold and fire against purple. Measured over the game's art: near-black #240d0f 26%, orange #e9800f 13%, dark purple #431a56 11%, brown #804309 11%, gold #f6c723 6%, light gold #fdfcf7 4%, dark red #740505 3%. The four jackpots own purple (MINI), blue (MINOR), green (MAJOR) and red (GRAND), repeated on coin, plaque and win word; the three win tiers are purple, blue and red. The amounts are purple numerals with a gold rim. Steel grey appears once, on the horseshoe.
Money Gong EmpressPurple ground, gold objects. Measured over all of the game's art: near-black #180c0c at 17% and dark purple #450657 at 13% lead; hues are orange 40%, yellow 21%, purple 17%, red 10%; warm 64% against cool 16%, saturation 0.63, brightness 0.39. The backgrounds and the reel backing are purple only (#39034d, #3d0156; hues 100% purple). The other colours are a code kept from the sister game: green #04ed61 is the money ball, the gong's features each have a colour, and each jackpot tier has its own (Grand red, Major green, Maxi purple, Minor blue, Mini orange). Red survives only on the gong's emblem, the firecrackers, the logo's extrusion and the multipliers.
Mega Cash Boost Hold And WinRed field, gold and cyan signs. Measured over the art files: near-white #fafaf8 21% (the white light sprites, which the game tints), gold #f7c030 11%, orange #f08617 10%, red #f2292e 10%, dark red #ab2b0f 3%, dark purple-blue #19083b 2%. On screen the backdrop is set by tints in the skeleton files: near-black wine #1f0014 under red #be1000 and #ff0000 beams. The code is strict: cyan-blue is Cash (plates, Blue Diamond, blue Booster), gold is Jackpot (plates, Gold Diamond, gold Booster), red is both (Red Diamond, the frame, the field), and the logo's three words carry the same three colours. Purple belongs to the Wild alone.
Freedom 250x Boost Hold And WinRed, white and blue hold the stage; gold holds everything that pays. Measured over the art files: orange-gold #d7911e 12%, near-white #fbfaf5 11%, dark red #56090a 10%, red #a01c1b 9%, blue #2d78c2 8%, near-black navy #0d1830 8%, gold #f4c64a 4%, light blue #76bae6 3%. The backdrop is half navy, half red (hues blue 0.518, red 0.482); the board is pale sky blue so the warm symbols stand out. A second code names the prizes: purple Unity, blue Justice, green Freedom, red Glory, and the win tiers borrow those colours (magenta BIG, green SUPER, gold MEGA, blue TOTAL). Gold against full colour separates cash from jackpot: the Cash Collector and its coins are all gold, the Jackpot Collectors are in natural colour.
Frankensteins FortuneMeasured over the game's own art: vivid (saturation 78%), mid-to-dark (brightness 36%), cool 63% against warm 12%. Black-green #0d1610 26%, dark green #296909 17%, dark blue #112e45 9%, teal #0b887d 8%, bright green #38b512 4%, purple #3b126f 3%; green is 52% of the coloured pixels. The scheme: teal fog and violet shadow for the room, acid green for electricity and light, copper for the frame, and gold with a red edge only for money (cash balls, win numerals, COLLECT). Three bonus games are told apart by colour alone, red, green and blue, and four jackpots by green, blue, magenta and red.
Huff N Lots Of GoalsGreen field, red and blue teams, gold prizes. Measured over the game's own captured art: cream-white #f9f7ea 19%, pale orange #ead5bc 10% (smoke and cream fills weigh heavily), grass green #86c70c 9%, black #0a0f0b 5%, wolf blue #565b82 5%, yellow #f4ec13 3%. The background is 61% green hues with a red and pink crowd; the feature balls sit on pure red and royal blue squares; royals are one emerald green (#1c6c38); the coin is 96% warm. Prize tiers keep one colour each on plaque and wedge: magenta Mini, green Minor, blue Major, red Grand, gold Super.
3 Blazing Chilis Hold And WinMeasured over the game's art: dusty wine #60373f 12%, dark wine #371819 12%, terracotta #b45832 11%, sand #ca996b 10%, near-white #f5f7f5 9%, mauve #7e5966 8%, pale sand #eac596 8%, gold #fbd945 2%. A warm palette of cream, terracotta and red with green as the foil. Colour carries the rules: green, yellow and red for the three chilis, in value order (1x, 2x, 5x the stake), repeated on their words, their effect marks and the logo; red and gold, orange, cyan and purple for GRAND, MAJOR, MINOR and MINI; cyan, orange and red for BIG, SUPER and MEGA WIN; one hue per letter symbol. The bonus keeps every game piece and changes the world to violet and deep blue with orange lights.
The Goonies Quest For Treasure 2Measured over the game's own art: black-brown #1c0c0c 19%, brown #572817 18% and #8e4b23 15%, then light gold #f8eb87 3% and one dark blue #273145 2%. Almost every unit measures 80 to 100% warm. The reel board is the exception (dark blue #152035, 94% of its unit) and is what the gold symbols are read against. Identity colours are used as codes, not decoration: blue, red and green for the three chests and their bonus symbols; gold, green, red and blue for the four collectors; yellow, green, blue and red for the four jackpot plates; cyan (#0cceff) for anticipation and One-Eyed Willy Spins; acid green (#53ff60, #78ff0b) for the Mystery Symbol and the lock.
Triple Cash EruptionWarm and dark overall. Measured over the game's own art: black #180908 24%, dark red #581413 14%, red #88172c 8%. Against that the reel cells are teal (#079a8f, #04655d), the one cool field in the base game, so warm symbols sit on their complement. Colour is also the rule system: red is the Multiplier volcano and fireball, green is Collect, blue is Double, orange is plain cash; the jackpots are orange (Grand), magenta (Major), blue (Minor) and green (Mini), and the multipliers are 2X blue, 3X green, 5X magenta. Fire leans to magenta and pink in the sky and haze (#780539, #d1065e) rather than staying orange.
Break The Diamond PiggyWhite, cream and pool blue as the ground, gold as the money, and saturated enamel colours for whatever must be told apart. Measured over the art files: near-white #f4f6f2 10% (the ship, the haze and white effect sprites), near-black violet #130616 9% (the lounge and outlines), gold-orange #eeb711 9%, grey #bbb8b6 8%, brown #7e3610 8%, blue #095cb9 5%, cream #f5ddb6 4%, dark blue #0e1557 3%. The board is the lightest large surface (cream #f5dbbd, brightness 0.84), which is rare for a slot: symbols are dark and saturated on a pale ground. Ice blue is reserved for the diamond (Wild, Diamond Piggy: 93% cool); a five-colour scale ranks the royals and, separately, the jackpot plates.
Bigger Piggy Bank SuperwheelMeasured over the game's own art: mid-tone, saturated (59%), warm 52% against cool 40%, high contrast; the largest measured areas are the dark navy and plum grounds (#131025, #372e63, #683a50). On them sit three candy families: pig pink and magenta (#f676b7, #fe30a2), gold (#f4d020, #bc7d0b) and money green (#63b53e), with cyan (#08f9f1) behind pink pigs and feature tiles. Four prize colours are fixed everywhere: red Grand, purple Major, blue Minor, green Mini. The shared wheel adds its own red (#c90402).
777 Hot Reels MegachargedMeasured over the game's art: near-black purple #1f0a2c 27%, red #9d2117 14%, orange #e96d0f 13%, gold #f9c013 11%, light golds #fdfbf3 and #fbed86 9% together, hot red #f11f07 3%, dark blue #0c0872 1%. The code is three hues: blue for the single seven and MINI, purple for the double seven and MINOR, red for the triple seven and MAJOR, repeated on symbol, plaque, jackpot win, gem and particle. Gold is the Wild, the frame, the logo and every amount. Cyan appears only as electricity.
Capital GainsGreen, gold and black, with blue as the charge. Measured over the game's own art: black #060f09 33%, black-teal #0e3e2f 10%, orange-gold #e79510 10%, white #f3f9f8 5%, dark green #0d6d06 4%, blue #0366f6 3%, green #06a04b 2%; saturation 0.67, warm 39% against cool 41%; hues green 31%, orange 22%, blue 13%, yellow 12%. The base background is two greens only (#046c31, #04af53). Each high symbol owns a tile colour (diamond red, gold bars blue, notes purple, coins dark green) and each letter one flat colour (A red, K blue, Q yellow, J green). The free spins swap the field to red (#ce110a). Jackpot tiers: Grand red, Major green, Minor blue, Mini purple. Lightning is #0269f7 with a white core.
CleopatraGold on purple. Measured over the game's own art the palette is gold #f0c70a (15%), orange #de7f25 (13%), near-black #120a04, sand #eeca79, brown #67370a, red #861425 and cream #f9e9bc; saturation 0.76, warm 90% against cool 6%. The backdrop is the counter-colour, magenta #9d1cae and purple #6a0cca in the base game, and turns dark red #880d30 in the free spins. The reel cells are cream #f8e6bf in the base game and tan #e8c684 in the free spins. Each picture symbol owns a cloth colour (scarab green #3a8467, lotus violet #753e7e, cartouche blue #3f55b1, crook and flail yellow #e8ad1e, eye red #b92911) and each of the 20 paylines owns a bead colour that its line and cell frames repeat.
Mystery Of The Lamp Secret BazaarMeasured over the game's own art, the palette is led by near-black #0a0509 (26%), dark red #501614 (8%) and dark blue-violet #2c2842 (8%), then near-white #f7f8f5 and golds #f6d117 and #f9f15c. On screen the board is deep red with gold, the street warm orange and rose with violet-blue shadow, and the controls violet and blue with yellow glyphs. Colour carries meaning: each picture symbol has one smoke colour (violet, yellow, orange-red, green), each lamp one glass colour (blue Collect, pearl Jackpot, orange Ignite), each of the five prizes one title colour (red Grand, green Major, magenta Maxi, cyan Minor, orange Mini), and magenta-pink is kept for money won (the win frame and the win digits). The bonus cave turns the whole palette cool: blue #474ebe leads it at 56%.
The Lucky Fella Hold And WinDark green and dark purple fields under gold and a full rainbow. Measured over the art files: near-black green #0b290b 17%, near-white #fcfbf7 11% (white effect sprites the game tints), dark magenta #36082e 10%, gold-orange #f2bb19 7%, wood brown #682b16 6%, purple #550867 3%, green #0c750e 2%. Gold marks what pays (coins, pots, WILD, frame, jackpot names); the rainbow marks what is magic (ribbon, progress meter, Collector panel, Jackpot Coin, transitions); and a five-step rainbow scale ranks things: purple, blue, green, red and gold for the royals and for the jackpot banners.
Serpent Gold Hold And WinMeasured over the game's art: near-black brown #18130f 29%, jungle grey-green #526254 14%, dark wine #392d2c 10%, pale grey #b8b7b5 6%, orange-brown #a53b11 5%, near-white #f9f9f7 4%, pale green #83927f 3%, deep red #601a0a 1%. The base game is green haze around a dark brown board with gold; the bonus turns the surround to red stone, violet and orange. Colour carries the rules: red, green and blue for Collect, Clone and Double (heads, frames, gems, side lights, the NEW SNAKE words); purple, blue, green, red-orange and gold for MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND and ULTIMATE; one hue per letter symbol; gold for anything that pays; jade green for the value on a coin.
Huff N Puff Money MansionWarm cast on a cyan sky. Symbols and props are gold, orange and red (reel stills: #f9dd0c 14%, #750f05 10%; hat rig: #f8ad0a 27%, #e05a0a 18%); the day background is red brick and gold under cyan (#5cceed, #12bef8); the wolf is blue-violet (#6d72a0, #9099c7). Royals are a single emerald green. Prize tiers keep one colour each wherever they appear: red Grand, blue Major, green Minor, magenta Mini; the mansion's prize plates are gold at the top, blue in the middle, dark at the bottom. The palette measured over all captured art (#6d729f 21%, #8f9ac8 15%, #c0c5cf 10%) is the wolf's, because his frames fill 132 of the 349 textures; it is not what the screen looks like.
Money Gong EmperorRed and gold with almost no cool colour: measured over the game's own art, dark red #600d04 at 20% and near-black #1d0d08 at 18% lead, then gold-orange #edb517 at 8%; warm 74% against cool 4%, saturation 0.62, brightness 0.39. Hues are orange 43%, red 33%, yellow 19%, green 3%. Colour outside red and gold is rationed and always means something: green #06ed61 is the money ball, green, blue, purple and red-gold are the gong's four features, and each jackpot tier has a colour of its own (Grand red, Major green, Maxi purple, Minor blue, Mini orange); magenta is the top prize's figure; the multiplier is red with a white outline.
Super Cash Boost Big Bad BonusMeasured over the game's art: dark forest greens #192f29 19% and #375d56 10%, near-white #eef2f0 9% (smoke, numerals), brick brown #8d3d17 6%, warm yellow #f3d07a 6%, sky blues #6498bd 6% and #a7cfe1 4%, straw #efdaae 2%. The scene is green and blue, the interface warm brown, tan and gold, and the symbols take one saturated hue each. Jackpots are coded by colour: MINI magenta, MINOR blue, MAJOR green, MEGA red-orange, GRAND gold. Frame metal ranks the pigs: steel, copper, gold.
Zeus vs Hades POPTwo opposed families and one shared metal. Zeus and the base game: cyan and blue (#22efff, #2b7cf2, #3986ce, #324382). Hades and free spins: red, orange and dark crimson (#8e1f15, #540e19, #d92d11, #f49419). Gold (#f9ea77, #f49419) trims every symbol and frame on both sides. Purple marks what belongs to neither god (the VS coin's galaxy, the Ace, cloth shadows). Lime, pink and cyan neon appear only on the three POP prize fields. Measured over the game's own art: vivid (saturation 63%), mid-tone, warm 54% against cool 40%.
Lighting
GameLighting
Cash EruptionFire is the light everywhere: the hall is lit from below and in front as if by firelight, the fireball and flames are self-lit, the wild is lit warm from the fire behind her. The regular symbols alone have a neutral studio light from the upper left with a star glint.
Huff N Even More Puff GrandNight scene lit from inside the picture by lamps; objects are top-lit with hard gloss. Glow is kept as separate additive layers and outline sprites (hat glow, wedge glow, row highlight), not painted in. On screen the reel window is the darkest area and the wheel and lawn the brightest.
Fire Rail Express Hold And WinObjects are lit from the upper left or front with a red-orange rim from below right; the backdrop's fire lights from the bottom of the screen. Lamps, coins' flames and all effects are self-lit.
Money Gong EmpressOne top light on everything (measured from the top on 189 parts, top-right on 29, top-left on 19) with specular glints on the gold; the grounds are dark (brightness 0.07 to 0.09) with a low magenta glow, so the gold objects are the light of the screen.
Mega Cash Boost Hold And WinSelf-lit neon everywhere; there is no light source in a scene because there is no scene. Objects are lit from the top or top-left with a blue rim from below, as if standing on a lit sign. Glow circles behind the board make the centre the brightest area.
Freedom 250x Boost Hold And WinBright, even studio light from above and the upper left on every object, with small white hot spots on metal; no cast shadows between pieces except the drop shadows painted into the bunting and scroll. The backdrop glows from its centre behind the board and is the darkest layer (brightness 0.254), the symbols the brightest.
Frankensteins FortuneLight comes from the things in the picture: electrode balls, plasma, liquid in jars, lightning, the storm sky. Objects are top-lit (measured: light from the top on 163 parts, top-left and top-right on about 50 each) with a coloured glow behind them. The reel backing is unlit black, so everything luminous reads against it.
Huff N Lots Of GoalsDaylight, even and shadowless, for the base game; the file named for the free game is the same stadium at night under six floodlights. Objects are top-lit with hard gloss. Glow is kept as separate layers and outline sprites. On screen the reel window is the darkest area and the pitch the brightest.
3 Blazing Chilis Hold And WinBase game: high sun from the upper right, soft short shadows. Bonus: moonlight with warm pools from windows, a lantern and strings of bulbs. Game pieces carry their own top light and do not take the scene's; fire lights itself and gives the chilis a rim.
The Goonies Quest For Treasure 2The scene has three lights by colour: orange from the skull-shaped cave mouth and two lanterns, teal-green daylight behind the stair, purple in the shadowed rock, with a warm pool on the floor under the reels. Objects are lit from the top left. Prizes glow from inside (coin heaps, the ruby, the chests), and every win or feature state is an added coloured light in the object's own shape.
Triple Cash EruptionSymbols are lit from the top left with a soft shadow below. Everything that pays is self-lit: fireballs, lava, halos and frames glow past their own edges. Both backgrounds are lit from one hot source in the middle (the crack in the temple wall, the lava lake) and fall dark at the sides, which keeps the panels and the board readable.
Break The Diamond PiggyHigh daylight: objects are lit from the top, top-left or top-right with warm red-orange core shadows and white glints, and a white haze is painted into the middle of the backdrop behind the board. The bonus lounge reverses it: a dark room with stage spots, pink and gold on the ceiling and cyan light from the crystal pig.
Bigger Piggy Bank SuperwheelTop and top-left light on every object (measured: top 91, top-left 53, top-right 41 of the parts with a readable light side). Each symbol ships a 'Light' and a 'Light Hit' copy of itself as an additive layer for its flash, plus thin light sweeps. The hall is lit warm from windows and a ceiling lightbox against cool walls; the bonus room is lit by its own gold.
777 Hot Reels MegachargedAlmost everything is self-lit: neon, lamps behind plates, fire. Symbols have a conventional upper-left light and a warm halo. The backdrop's light comes from one vanishing point behind the cabinet.
Capital GainsA plain light from above on nearly everything (top on 354 parts measured, top-right 81, top-left 55), with white streak highlights on gold. No scene lighting, no cast light between objects. Lightning and the vault symbol's landing flash are self-lit.
CleopatraNo scene lighting. Each object carries its own frontal highlight; the cabinet has banded reflections like polished metal; the Sphinx (scatter and Big Win) and the fire are self-lit. The backdrop is a plain vertical gradient with no sun or lamp.
Mystery Of The Lamp Secret BazaarTwo lights in the base scene: warm lantern light from the stalls and the ground, cool dusk from above. Symbols are lit softly from the upper left with their smoke as a back light. Lamps glow from inside. The cave is lit by blue shafts from above.
The Lucky Fella Hold And WinObjects are lit from the top or top-right with a green bounce from below, as if standing in the clover field. The backdrop is darkest in the middle so the board glows against it. In the feature scene the light source is the rainbow ribbon itself.
Serpent Gold Hold And WinDiffuse daylight from above through mist in the base scene; a low orange sun and coloured haze in the bonus. Game pieces are lit from the top with their own highlights and do not take the scene's light. The statue is lit from above until its mouth and eyes light it from inside.
Huff N Puff Money MansionDaylight from above on a clear day; objects are top-lit with hard gloss. Glow is kept as separate additive layers and outline sprites (hat glow, frame pulses, plate highlights), not painted in. The background is repainted for evening and night, with lit windows and lantern pools at night, and the prize plates have day and night versions to follow it.
Money Gong EmperorOne top light on everything (measured from the top on 174 parts, top-right on 32, top-left on 19) with specular glints on the gold; the backgrounds are dark with a low glow, so the gold objects are the light of the screen. The base reel backing is the darkest surface (#550202, brightness 0.07).
Super Cash Boost Big Bad BonusDaylight from the upper right in the base scene and a low sunset behind the hills in the special scene; props and plates are lit from the upper left; characters have a warm key and a thin cool rim. Nothing glows by itself except a plate being boosted.
Zeus vs Hades POPEach side is lit by its own element: cool cyan light from lightning on Zeus pieces, warm light from fire on Hades pieces, usually against the opposite temperature in the shadows (purple-blue shadows on warm skin). Bevels are top-lit. Lightning, fire, frame edges and eyes are emissive and drawn as separate additive layers, so glow is a layer, not paint.
Ambience
GameAmbience
Cash EruptionHot, enclosed and ceremonial in the base game; hotter in the free spins; vast and ominous in the bonus, under a red spiral sky. Over it sits the plain cheer of a classic fruit machine: the theme is a dressing on familiar symbols, not a story.
Huff N Even More Puff GrandCheerful, loud and crowded, as the base-game screens show: the wheel, the rolling sign, six plaques and the logo all compete around a dark reel window, and the calm garden is reduced to a green and blue margin. The wolf is a comic villain, present in the base game only as a tail swishing under the reels. The pace of wins and features is not known from this run.
Fire Rail Express Hold And WinA furnace and a ticket office: hot, rich, a little nostalgic. The base game is half fire and half cool purple; the cash bonus turns the backdrop to gold and purple postcards, the jackpot bonus to fire across the whole screen.
Money Gong EmpressFestive, lucky and rich, and softer than the sister game: the same New Year firecrackers, coins and pots of gold, in a night-purple room with lotus, fan and koi and a smiling empress. Calm in the base game; the bonus spins turn the board itself gold.
Mega Cash Boost Hold And WinHigh voltage, arcade and motorsport: fast, loud, synthetic. The mood comes from motion of light, not from a place or a story.
Freedom 250x Boost Hold And WinA Fourth of July parade and an awards ceremony at once: festive, proud, polished, without irony. Fireworks open the game and confetti never stops.
Frankensteins FortuneSpooky but cosy and funny: a Halloween cartoon, with the machine always humming. The base game is the lab at night; Cash Trail goes outside to the stormy hill and castle; Big Money is a shelf of specimen jars; Frankie Spins darkens the lab and lights only the prizes.
Huff N Lots Of GoalsMatch day with a full house: cheerful, loud, busy. The wheel, two goals, five plaques and an animated logo crowd the top of the screen around a calm dark reel window. The villain is a joke: the wolf's threat is a whistle. A win of ten times the bet was marked by a gold light burst and a one-line caption, no more.
3 Blazing Chilis Hold And WinA holiday lunch at a street grill: sunny, generous, a little comic (the deadpan hen, the chef who breathes fire and coins when the chilis ignite). The bonus is the same street at fiesta time, hotter and more intimate.
The Goonies Quest For Treasure 2Adventure, not horror: a treasure hunt by lantern light, with skeletons played for fun and the film's catchphrases (NEVER SAY DIE!, HEY YOU GUYS!) used as art. The board always shows the long game: the trail map above and the three chests beside the reels.
Triple Cash EruptionFamiliar and safe on the reels, loud and hot around them. The base game is an expectant temple chamber; the bonus drops into the crater, darker and redder, where gold numbers in fire rings are the only bright things. The opening is a short disaster film: eruption, flaming rocks at the camera, title, wipe to yellow.
Break The Diamond PiggyCarefree, rich and a little cheeky: a luxury holiday where the only job is breaking piggy banks. Day on deck for the base game; a night version of the deck and a casino lounge for the features (the last two read from the files and the intro, not seen in play).
Bigger Piggy Bank SuperwheelFriendly greed: money as sweets and toys, nothing sinister about the bank. The base game is a calm night hall with a mascot watching from the top of the reels; the bonus is the inside of the vault, all gold. The shared Super Wheel brings a louder, studio-lights mood from outside the theme.
777 Hot Reels MegachargedA machine in a dark club, humming with neon, that catches fire when a feature starts. The base game is cool and purple, Free Spins and the intro are orange and red; the cabinet itself does not change.
Capital GainsBright, clean and blunt: the promise is money itself. Calm in the base game, hotter by colour alone in the free spins, and charged when the lightning locks the green discs in the bonus.
CleopatraOpulent, calm and familiar: a jewel box at dusk. The base game is cool purple around warm gold; the free spins heat the whole screen to crimson and age the reels to tan papyrus. Nothing moves until a win, so the game feels like a machine rather than a scene.
Mystery Of The Lamp Secret BazaarA warm, rich evening market with a secret in it; friendly rather than mysterious, because the genie smiles and the smoke is pink. The cave is the cold, magical counter-scene.
The Lucky Fella Hold And WinCosy, lucky and good-humoured: a pub sign in a clover patch at night. The feature scene is the same place enchanted, not a different world.
Serpent Gold Hold And WinAn expedition that has found the temple: humid, hushed and green at first, with danger shown as beauty (jewel snakes, a sleeping statue). The bonus is heat and treasure: red walls, gold underfoot, the statue's eyes burning.
Huff N Puff Money MansionSunny, proud and busy, as the base-game screens show: the mansion fills the picture behind the reels, prize plates glow on its roof, four plaques stand at the left and the logo at the right, and the reel window is the one dark area. Wins in the base game are modest: a line of text names the ways at the foot of the reels, the wolf is boxed in gold, and a larger win ($12.00 at a $2.00 bet) puts gold digits on a flare. The wolf is a comic villain who appears in the base game only as a reel symbol. The pace of features is not known from this run: none came in about 32 spins.
Money Gong EmperorFestive, lucky and rich: New Year firecrackers, coins, pots of gold and a laughing emperor. Calm in the base game, where the screen is a dark red wall with gold furniture; the bonus spins turn the board itself gold.
Super Cash Boost Big Bad BonusSunny, rustic and good-humoured. The base game is a building site in a meadow at midday; the intro shows the finished village at sunset with the wolf waiting. Threat is played as comedy.
Zeus vs Hades POPA playful rivalry rather than a solemn myth: loud, bright, friendly menace. The base game is an airy storm sky, calm between flashes; free spins is a hot, busy underworld of lava falls, chains and stone pillars. POP moments switch to soap bubbles and pastel rainbow, closer to a casual mobile game than to the Greek set.
Shapes
GameShapes
Cash EruptionRound, full, simple silhouettes for the symbols; rectangles and thin rails for every frame; the step-fret (a squared spiral) as the one ornament, repeated on frames, button rings, the coin, the ribbon ends, the cell pattern and even the watermelon seeds.
Huff N Even More Puff GrandRound and chunky everywhere: domed hats, circular saws and coins, rounded topiary, bubble letters. Sharpness is kept for the saw teeth, the wolf's muzzle and ears, and spark bursts.
Fire Rail Express Hold And WinCircles (coins, wheel, boiler door, fire rings), the perforated ticket rectangle, rounded plaques with one cut corner, a thin square frame, fat slab-serif letters.
Money Gong EmpressCircles everywhere: gong, coins, money balls, jackpot discs, round buttons, the ring in the background, the bonus wheel. Around them, cloud scrolls and a Greek-key band as the two ornaments, and pill-shaped plaques for every figure. The lettering is the one angular element.
Mega Cash Boost Hold And WinThe slanted parallelogram (plates, backplates, frame corners), the chevron (board pattern, meter fill, boost arrows), the lightning zigzag (logo, letters' notches, the container's ends, the effects) and the faceted diamond. Circles appear only on the Wild and the coin.
Freedom 250x Boost Hold And WinThe five-point star (backdrop, medals, ribbons, the empty cell, the flying coin), the round medal, the scroll ribbon with curled ends, the laurel branch, and the stripe. The board is a plain rounded rectangle so the round and ribboned shapes read against it.
Frankensteins FortuneRound and chunky: cylinders, domes, balls and fat letters. The angular shapes are lightning, thorny vines and bare trees, used for energy and for the outdoors. Frames are copper pipe or thin gold; the Collect symbol breaks the grid with a vine border.
Huff N Lots Of GoalsRound everywhere: balls, coins, cups, domed buttons, bubble letters, puffs of smoke. Points are kept for the wolf's muzzle and ears, the pennant wedges of the wheel and star ornaments.
3 Blazing Chilis Hold And WinRound and plump everywhere: curved chilis, barrel cacti, a domed sombrero, a round-faced chef, rounded slab letters. The chili silhouette is the game's mark and is reused as a shape: the logo sign and win plate are a chili-shaped wooden board, a glow has a chili-shaped hole, the coin is embossed with a chili. Zigzag bands (poncho, sombrero, letters) are the second repeated motif.
The Goonies Quest For Treasure 2Chunky and irregular: hand-cut slab letters, torn parchment, hammered coins with uneven rims, faceted rock. The reel cell is a wide 215x180 rectangle, 6 reels by 4 rows; the collector grows from one cell to a 215x720 column. Round medallions and rectangles with value plates repeat across the prize symbols.
Triple Cash EruptionRound and soft for everything collectable (fruit, bell, globes); square for everything structural (cells, frames, plates); the volcano cone is the one triangle and it is used as the game's badge. Frames are hairlines; the reel board has almost no body of its own.
Break The Diamond PiggyRound and fat throughout: piggy banks, coins, snouts, bellies, swim ring, fountain bowl, inflated letters. The counter-shapes are the hexagonal jackpot plates and the diamond's facets. Frames are thin and straight; nothing is ornate except the small gold leaf sprigs on the high-symbol tiles and the scrolls on the Wild.
Bigger Piggy Bank SuperwheelCircles and fat rounded squares: the pig is nearly a sphere, coins and wheels repeat it, tiles and panels have wide radii, letters are inflated. The snout (an oval with two holes) is the game's mark and is stamped on coins, bars, the case, the hammer, the vault and the carpet.
777 Hot Reels MegachargedThe seven above all: as symbol, jackpot plaque silhouette, win plate, 3D block and logo. Around it a pinched cabinet outline, chevrons, diamonds on the win lines, thin dotted bulb lines, fat slab letters.
Capital GainsRound and heavy: discs, coins, the vault wheel, the sack, the ring of the vault chamber. Rounded square tiles for high symbols. Slab-serif letters. The background's only ornament is banknote engraving: guilloche curves and scrollwork.
CleopatraSquare opaque cells in a strict grid; a symmetrical shrine frame with a curved cornice, two lotus columns and a boat-shaped base with fan prows; round beads and round buttons; the lotus fan as the repeating ornament (on the letters, the logo, the cabinet, the plaque).
Mystery Of The Lamp Secret BazaarRound and generous: bottle-bellied lamps, dome buttons, coins, cushion and heart-shaped gems, fat rounded royals. The frame answers with thin straight rails ending in curls. Smoke puffs and spirals soften every edge.
The Lucky Fella Hold And WinThe heart-shaped clover leaf is the module: backdrop leaves, the coin's stamp, the Scatter, the pipe's badge, the hat, the particles. Round bellies (pots, mug, barrel, coins, the character) against a thin wavy frame line; the curled scroll for jackpots; the arc for rainbows. The only sharp shape is the Booster arrow.
Serpent Gold Hold And WinDiamond snake heads and shield-shaped hoods; trapezoid plates in stepped-fret frames; slanted slab letters; round sun coins with spikes; square spiral frets on every frame end, lock plate and letter serif. The fret and the snake are the two repeated marks: the Wild, the win line's end, the win plate's ornament, the frame's corner and the opening wipe are all snakes.
Huff N Puff Money MansionRound and chunky everywhere: domed hats, coins, rounded topiary, bubble letters, pill buttons. Straight edges belong to the house: bricks, frames, plates, the hairline reel frame. Sharpness is kept for the wolf's ears and teeth, sparks and shards.
Money Gong EmperorCircles everywhere: gong, coins, money balls, jackpot discs, round buttons, the ring in the background, the bonus wheel. Around them, cloud scrolls and a Greek-key band as the two ornaments, and pill-shaped plaques for every figure. The lettering is the one angular element.
Super Cash Boost Big Bad BonusRound and soft everywhere: balloon letters, fat tools, plump pigs, puffed clouds and bushes. The pig's snout (an oval with two dots) is the repeated mark, on every letter, the tape measure, the hard hat, the toolbox, the coin and the reel panel's watermark. Square frames are kept for the Wilds and houses only.
Zeus vs Hades POPRounded and chunky throughout, with angular accents (spikes, zigzag lightning, flames) reserved for power and danger. Frames are thin rails with Greek-key corners; figures break out of their frames.

Huff N Lots Of GoalsStitched leather (ball), brushed steel (whistle), glossy boots, bronze, silver and gold (trophies, coin, frames), mown turf used as a frame material, netting and tube steel (goals), dark glass (plaques), enamel lettering, soap bubbles, riveted wood and hazard tape in the logo, cream cartoon smoke.
